scope: Current applicability questions; accepted current-source economics and engineering evidence are retained separately.
scan_rule: Follow research/registry.json families[].research_questions and select status=pending_validation. Read current_evidence separately; a pending hypothesis does not invalidate an accepted bounded result.

current_evidence.boundary: Fixed-input parity, defect-regression, restoration and performance measurements are retained as engineering observations at their original scope. They do not establish strategy profitability. New-source economic comparisons are indexed separately.

questions.question: Which economic claims survive a change of source, clock or execution semantics?
questions.question_zh: 数据源、时钟或执行语义改变后，哪些经济主张仍能成立？
gaps: Parity on one frozen input cannot validate the economics, data realism or live transfer of an old strategy.
Bind the actual source, model, baseline, action semantics, accounting and previous-use; an old point estimate or closure label is not a current conclusion.
questions.next_validation: Retain defect regressions and fixed-input parity as engineering evidence; economic applicability requires a separately identified matched current-source comparison.
